_README: Verified off-the-shelf parts catalog. Part numbers here are CURATED BY HAND and web-verified, never model-generated. The LLM builds geometry; the BOM generator reads part numbers from this file. That separation is deliberate: a hallucinated part number is the one error that costs real money.
_pricing: DELIBERATELY NULL. Get a live quote before publishing any price. Do not let anyone fill these in from memory.
series: 10 Series (1" x 1") - chosen over 15 Series because module walls are short (18" max unsupported) and 10 Series is lighter and cheaper. 15 Series would be over-built for this load.

profile.desc: 1" x 1" smooth surface T-slotted profile, four open T-slots
profile.note: TNUTZ EX-1010 is stated 100% compatible with 80/20 1010-S and they cut to length with ~48h turnaround. Primary drop-ship candidate.

fasteners.desc: 10 Series 2 Hole Gusseted Inside Corner Bracket
fasteners.note: Gusseted (heavy duty) chosen over the 4108 LITE version because these modules carry a loaded fridge and are repeatedly lifted by their corners.

fasteners.desc: 10 Series 2 Hole LITE Inside Corner Bracket, 1 x 1 x .125 x 1in, two .257in thru holes
fasteners.note: Lighter and cheaper. Acceptable for the gear/utility module which carries less.

fasteners.desc: 10 Series 10-32 Standard Anchor Fastener (slide-in T-nut + cam + 10-32 SHCS)
fasteners.note: Flush/concealed alternative to external brackets. Vibration resistance matters in a vehicle.

_unverified_still_to_source: Panel retainer / snap-in panel trim for capturing the side panels in the T-slot
Handles - specify an off-the-shelf recessed pull rather than a custom part
Drawer slides - off-the-shelf, 20in full-extension, load rating TBD by module
Quick-release locking pin for the vehicle tie-down (see custom parts - this may be the only genuinely custom item)
